description: Source code for disassembling IA-32 instructions, including functions for decoding ModR/M and SIB bytes, and disassembling instructions into an invariant representation.

methods.name: ia32_invariant_modrm
methods.description: Decodes ModR/M byte and SIB byte for IA-32 instruction decoding.

methods.name: ia32_decode_invariant
methods.description: Decodes operands of an IA-32 instruction into an invariant form.

methods.name: ia32_disasm_invariant
methods.description: Disassembles a buffer into an invariant representation of an IA-32 instruction.

methods.name: ia32_disasm_size
methods.description: Returns the size of an IA-32 instruction in bytes.
